{{Quote|I don't like this guy, Leia! He changes his tune faster than a ''Norkronian whistle-snake!''|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], upon meeting [[Zelor]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 49">[[Star Wars (1977) 49|''Star Wars'' (1977) 49]]</ref>}}
The '''Norkronian whistle-snake''' was a creature from the [[Norkronia system/Legends|Norkronia system]] that was famous for quickly altering sound intonations.<ref name="cswe">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
